title: UDP Receive
text: Receive UDP packet, 1 output, {Data type for Message} sets Data type of message; {Local IP port} sets the number of IP port, {Remote IP address (’0.0.0.0’ to accept all)} sets the iP address from which to accept packets, {Receive buffer size (bytes)} sets the size of buffer that receives UDP packets, {Maximum length for Message} sets the maximum length of output data, {Message is complex} sets the message data complexity, {Output variable-size signal} sets the message output that varies in length, {Blocking time (seconds)} sets the number of seconds to wait for UDP packet and {Sample time (seconds)} sets the frequency of calls to block. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Local IP port
params.values: Number of IP port 25000 (default) | scalar in the range [1, 65535]

params.name: Remote IP address (’0.0.0.0’ to accept all)
params.values: IP address from which to accept packets ’0.0.0.0’ (default) | IP address

params.name: Receive buffer size (bytes)
params.values: Size of buffer that receives UDP packets 8192 (default) | scalar in the range [1, 67108864]

params.name: Maximum length for Message
params.values: Maximum length of output data 255 (default) | scalar

params.name: Data type for Message
params.values: Data type of message uint8 (default) | single | double | int8 | int16 | int32 | int64 | uint16 | uint32 | uint64 | boolean | fixed point | enumerated | bus

params.name: Output variable-size signal
params.values: Message output that varies in length on (default) | off

params.name: Blocking time (seconds)
params.values: Number of seconds to wait for UDP packet inf (default) | scalar

params.name: Sample time (seconds)
params.values: Frequency of calls to block 0.01 (default) | scalar
